reviews.text: One of my fave lip balms. The colour is subtle and neutral and would suit most. It gives a nice glossy finish that isn't too much and makes you glow and look healthy. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我最愛嘅潤唇膏之一。顏色低調中性，應該適合大部分人。帶出自然光澤感唔會太重，望落會有光澤、健康嘅感覺。極推薦！

reviews.text: Super pretty color. I like these a lot more than AOU. The smell is very nice and fruity smell. I posted a picture to compare the color to the viral apple balm from AOU. The strawberry jam color is more pink than the apple balm.
reviews.zh: 超靚嘅顏色。比起 AOU 我鍾意呢款好多。味道好正，係水果香。我 post 咗相對比同 AOU 嗰款大熱蘋果 balm 嘅顏色。strawberry jam 呢款顏色比蘋果 balm 更加粉。

reviews.text:
i expected the color would be more solid.
It looks like a thicker version of Vaseline rose lip balm instead yet Vaseline only costs around 1/9 of this one.
reviews.zh: 我以為顏色會再實色啲。睇落似厚身版嘅凡士林玫瑰潤唇膏，但凡士林只係佢 1/9 價錢咋。

reviews.text: The most beautiful, moisturizing gloss! I've ordered several backups of the Cranberry shade. It's a perfect buildable dark red gloss. Layers well over blurred lip pencils or on its own.
reviews.zh: 最靚、最保濕嘅唇釉！Cranberry 呢隻色我已經後補咗幾支。係一款完美可以疊色嘅深紅唇釉。單用或者疊喺 blur 過嘅唇筆上面都好出色。

reviews.text: Lo compré porque estaba en oferta, en general es bueno, pero aun no me acostumbro al empaque, el color es muy lindo y se siente ligero en los labios, sin embargo no lo siento lo suficiente hidratante para ellos.
reviews.zh: 買佢係因為有特價，整體嚟講唔錯，不過仲未慣個包裝。顏色好靚，搽喺唇上感覺好輕，但係我覺得保濕度未夠。

reviews.text: I’ve had this for a couple of weeks now and it’s such a good product. The color pay off is really pretty, it’s moisturizing and it really is long lasting I’ve eaten and drank foods and it stays on most of it highly recommend purchasing! Please it smells so good🤩
reviews.zh: 我已經用咗幾個星期，呢款產品真係好正。顯色好靚，保濕又持久，食完嘢飲完嘢都仲 keep 到大部分，極推薦大家入手！拜託，佢味道真係好正🤩

reviews.text: not very thick or uncomfortable on lips and still moisturizing, but it is not long lasting and will erase easily; color payoff is very light just as I wanted and expected!
reviews.zh: 唔會好厚或者唔舒服，仍然保濕，但係唔持久，好容易就抹甩；顯色好淺，但正正係我想要同預期嘅效果！

reviews.text: These lip jams are so cute. The jar is kind of small but a little goes a long way. This is super pigmented! These are scented so if that bothers you I would stay away. Opening the package I could smell it right away. There is a seal so you know it hasn't been tampered with. Be careful if you apply too much because you really only need a tiny bit and it can get a bit sticky if you do over apply. This makes my dry lips look so smooth and glossy. It does stain my lips personally after I wipe it off but I would say it can transfer.
reviews.zh: 呢啲 lip jam 好得意。罐裝細細個，但係少量已經夠用。超顯色！呢啲有香味，如果介意嘅就唔好買。開箱嗰陣已經聞到。有封口，咁就知冇被開過。要留意唔好搽太多，因為真係只需要少少，搽太多會有少少黐。但係我啲乾唇望落即刻又滑又光亮。對我嚟講抆走之後會留有色喺唇上，但我會話佢會沾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
